purpose: Research candidate pool (~100 large US-listed ETFs, bucketed by US-equity sector + asset class) to SCREEN for viability in the options engine. This is a discovery list, NOT a promoted universe. AUM ranks are approximate (verify) and are NOT the gate -- options liquidity is (see etf_universe_screen.md). Frozen v2/v3 (31 symbols) remain the operating universe until a screened subset is pre-registered.
note_aum: Tickers chosen as well-known large-AUM ETFs per bucket. Several high-AUM names (VOO, VTI, BND, VEA, IEFA) are included ON PURPOSE as expected screen FAILURES -- high AUM, thin options -- to demonstrate AUM != option-tradable.
note_qlib: Symbols not already in qlib's ~76-ETF model universe have no point-in-time lean; the screen flags them as 'needs qlib coverage' (add to qlib data_fetch) or excludes them.
